citation.verbatim: The tender offer expired at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on June 5, 2024. A total of 119,018,767 shares of Monster's common stock were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share or as purchase price tenders... Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Process final tender results for ACCT-4407 using validly tendered shares as of expiration; do not submit any new election because the offer has expired; hold only fee/net-proceeds determination pending the missing Letter of Transmittal.

probe.derivation: The document store references the Letter of Transmittal, but the Letter of Transmittal is not included. Fees or charges, if any, to be deducted from tender proceeds are therefore not determinable from the provided store; escalate for the missing Letter of Transmittal and hold only the fee/deduction and net-proceeds release determination.
